The Marketplace team at Lyft is responsible for accelerating the growth of the business while simultaneously delivering on key business and financial metrics, and Dynamic Pricing & Offer Selection is an integral part of that. • Proficiency in SQL - able to write structured and efficient queries involving multiple large data sets

• Ability to collaborate and communicate with others to solve a problem

title: Senior Trust & Safety Engineer
description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Senior Software Engineer in Trust & Safety, you'll own the systems that decide how tradespeople are checked, how reviews are processed and how our marketplace stays honest at scale. You'll work alongside the vetting and reviews teams, who are on the front line of trust, and build the infrastructure that lets them work with confidence. When something breaks in production, you'll lead the response. When something looks brittle at design time, you'll say so.

The job, unfiltered:

- Own and evolve the systems behind how tradespeople are verified, how reviews flow through our platform and how content is moderated.

- Lead the response when things break: read distributed traces, correlate logs across services and find the cause, not just the symptom.

- Design event-driven workflows that are reliable by default: idempotent, retryable, with dead-letter handling that doesn't need a 2am wake-up to unpick.

- Work directly with the vetting and reviews teams to understand what trust means day to day, then build systems that hold up to it.

- Tighten the operational seams: better monitoring, clearer alerting, locked-down auth and outbox patterns that keep data consistent.

The fit:

- Strong TypeScript. You're comfortable owning a service end to end, from schema to deployment.

- Fastify or a similar Node.js framework, and enough HTTP know-how that it rarely surprises you.

- Event-driven instincts: you know what idempotency means in practice and why the outbox pattern exists.

- Full-stack comfort, Next.js included. You ship the frontend as happily as the service behind it.

- Datadog fluency (APM traces, log search, metric queries), SQL for diagnostics during an incident, and GCP basics such as Pub/Sub backlogs and DLQs.

- Experience leading production incidents, not just being in them. You communicate clearly under pressure and drive to a fix.

- An eye for systemic problems at review time, not at post-mortem time, and a habit of making the people around you better.

- Regular use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, and a keen interest in helping the team get more out of them.

You don't need to know our Trust & Safety domain yet (the review lifecycle, vetting disposition logic, publish timing). You'll pick it up. What matters is that you learn fast and take it seriously.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Gym membership, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

- Screening call with one of our Talent Acquisition Partners

- Technical interview with members of the team

- Final stage with the hiring manager and a senior stakeholder

We’re Checkatrade - the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work

title: Partnerships Account Manager
description:
Remote role in the USA
Role Overview 🚀
Uncapped lends working capital to e-commerce sellers across the UK, US and Canada. Some of that business comes through partners: credit brokers, affiliates, agencies, software companies and embedded platforms who introduce sellers to us. Brokers are our largest partner group.
We are looking for someone to own that channel completely. You will decide which partners we go after, bring them in, get them referring, and be accountable for the revenue that comes out of it. It is a broad remit and a visible one. The channel's number is reported weekly and you will be the person who explains it.
You will have a proper stack behind you. PartnerStack is the partner system of record, HubSpot is the CRM, Clay handles enrichment and list building, Instantly and HeyReach run outbound, and Customer.io runs lifecycle comms. All of it is live and already connected, so your time goes on partners and programs rather than on setting tools up.
This is a hands-on role. You will do the prospecting, build the campaigns and run the reporting yourself. Marketing will build assets you brief and Analytics will build you reporting you ask for, but nobody is dedicated to this channel. If you want to manage a book of relationships and have someone else own the pipeline, the tools and the numbers, this is not the right job. If you want a channel that is genuinely yours to run, it is.
About Uncapped 👫
Founded in 2019, Uncapped is a leading fintech provider of working & growth capital to e-commerce companies in North America and Europe. We leverage multiple data sources and use cutting-edge models to make credit decisions faster and safer. We work with some of the largest global e-commerce platforms - including Amazon and Walmart - and strive to be the best alternative lender globally.
What will you do ✍️
1. Recruitment: bring new partners in
Build and work the pipeline of new brokers, affiliates, agencies and platforms. Source lists in Clay, run sequences through Instantly and HeyReach, take the meetings, agree terms, and get them live in PartnerStack. You are doing your own prospecting.
2. Activation: get them to a first funded deal
Signing a partner is the easy part. Getting them to send a first deal, and then a second, is where most partner programs stall. Own the path from signed agreement to first submission to first funded deal, and set yourself a time limit on it.
3. Top partners management: keep them close and keep them informed
The partners who produce need real attention. Regular contact, honest feedback on what is converting and what is not, quarterly reviews, co-marketing, early sight of new products. A lot of this is teaching. A broker who understands what we lend against and who we lend to will send better deals, not just more of them.
4. The long tail: run it as a program
Most of the base will never justify a monthly call. Those partners still need to hear from us, so build the always-on layer that reaches them: segmented Customer.io journeys, newsletters, product and rate updates, reactivation campaigns, and self-serve material in the partner portal. Decide what good looks like for this group and measure whether the program is working.
5. Deal outcomes: own the channel's number
Our AEs work the deals that partners send. You are still accountable for what happens to them. Chase deals that stall, unblock what is stuck in underwriting, make sure partners hear back, and fix routing when a deal sits with the wrong person. Close the loop with partners on declines and losses so their next submission is better.
6. Partner economics and commission
Commission is a share of the fees we earn, and the rate varies by partner. You will run the payouts, keep attribution accurate, and understand what each partner costs us against what they bring in. Bring us recommendations on which rates should change.
7. Reporting and forecasting
Own the weekly channel report and the forecast: applications, approvals, funded deals and

The main purpose of the Account Manager is to manage their assigned clients and their stores by planning, briefing, monitoring, and executing marketing campaigns aimed at driving conversions and sales.
This includes managing, overseeing, and taking charge of the client-agency relationship for all the clients that have been assigned to you. It also includes developing and executing marketing strategies, handling client communications, writing client reports, and communicating the client’s marketing needs to other team members. You will be responsible for supplying the information your team needs to ensure that all marketing campaigns are written, designed, and executed as well as possible. Your goal as an Account Manager is to assist your clients in meeting their revenue goals using the products and services of our company.
The Account Manager will report directly to the Head of Account Managers, the Account Managers’ Leads, and the Service Director while working collaboratively with other departments.
About the Role:
Mission statement:
The primary mission of our Account Manager is to be in charge of maintaining a good relationship with your assigned clients while ensuring that our products and services are bringing results for our clients. This will include coming up with innovative ideas for clients’ marketing campaigns, monitoring the performance of such marketing campaigns, and keeping an open channel of productive and fruitful communication with our clients.
You will also be responsible for leading teams consisting of professional Copywriters, Designers, and Account Managers’ Associates to ensure that your assigned clients’ marketing campaigns are executed smoothly. This involves activities such as outlining the client's campaign calendar, briefing new campaigns, delegating creative work, and ultimately overseeing the timely delivery of marketing campaigns.
General Responsibilities:

• Effectively managing, overseeing, and ensuring that the marketing campaigns of your assigned clients are executed and performing well

• Building and maintaining a strong relationship with your assigned clients to ensure peak productivity, open communication, and establishing trust between our clients and Hustler Marketing

• Being in charge of the planning, development, and execution of marketing strategies (consisting of email campaigns, SMS campaigns, pop-ups, and flows) for your assigned clients (meaning that you’ll be managing about 40 unique marketing campaigns per month)

• Ensuring that the needs and expectations of your assigned clients are managed and met

• Working to improve the results from email marketing for your assigned clients

• Collaborating with team members to respond to client requests promptly

• Working alongside a team of experienced marketing professionals productively and harmoniously to ensure that the highest quality marketing campaigns are delivered to our clients

• Continuously staying in contact with your assigned clients, including leading and attending regular meetings with your clients

• Collecting and analyzing data to understand the consumers’ demographics and trends to forward the clients' marketing agenda and drive better results, setting new goals weekly

• Regularly reporting on the performance of the email marketing campaigns for your assigned clients, including reporting on aspects like revenue from email marketing, best-performing campaigns, results from A/B testing, and the measures taken to improve and optimize client revenue

• Working with the Service Department to maintain high work standards and ensuring that the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Keeping a tight grip on client churn (especially for your assigned clients), and implementing strategies to prevent clients from leaving the company, with the assistance of the Service Director

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
At SPD Technology , we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.
And now we are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join us as part of our team.
About the role
PitchBook - a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of more than three million companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others.
Our Tech Stack
Java, Spring, React, Typescript, Apache Beam, Flink, Python, LangGraph, GCP/AWS, K8s.

Work Environment
Flexible schedule with participation in team ceremonies and cross-functional collaboration. Time zone: Europe/Kyiv.
As a qualified expert, You will

• Solve strategic engineering problems hands on. Explore technologies, build prototypes, and produce reference implementations that make architectural qualities and tradeoffs observable.

• Design and deliver working software. Architect, implement, test, and maintain services and platform components, including backend systems and architecture-related frontend concerns such as micro-frontend patterns.

• Automate architectural conformance. Design and implement AI-based architectural conformance checks and fitness functions that continuously evaluate whether systems follow agreed principles, patterns, and quality constraints.

• Turn ambiguity into an executable approach. Break complex problems into bounded areas, apply domain-driven design, and select a practical course of action when information or precedent is limited.

• Define measurable quality goals. Establish and continuously evaluate requirements for performance, scalability, reliability, security, availability, recoverability, maintainability, portability, usability, and extensibility.

• Document architecture evolution. Describe the current state, target state, transition steps, constraints, alternatives, and decisions in forms that engineering teams can use.

• Make explicit engineering tradeoffs. Provide balanced recommendations on build versus buy, now versus later, and refactor versus rebuild, including cost and operational implications.

• Create reusable engineering patterns. Develop scaffolding, templates, reference architectures, or platform capabilities that teams can adopt without depending on the Staff Software Engineer long term.

• Guide delivery teams. Perform architecture and design reviews, coach engineers through difficult decisions, and enable teams to make high-quality choices independently.

• Communicate for the audience. Explain technical context clearly to engineers, technical leaders, product managers, and business stakeholders, and incorporate useful feedback.

We’re looking for you if you have

• A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• At least 6 years of experience in software engineering using Java or a comparable object-oriented language.

• At least 3 years developing microservices and experience building distributed or event-driven systems in the cloud.

• Practical knowledge of service-oriented architecture, domain-driven design, clean architecture, hexagonal architecture, and common architecture patterns.

• Experience implementing agentic applications and tools applying evaluation approaches as part of the process

title: Commercial Finance Business Development Partner
description:
Commercial Finance Business Development Partner

Commission Only | Remote | Flexible | Uncapped Earnings

We’re looking for someone who knows the commercial finance market and, more importantly, already has a strong network within it.

You might have worked for a lender, brokerage, finance network, software provider or another business selling into the sector. You’ll already know brokers, lenders and business owners and have relationships you can start working with.

This isn’t a role where we expect you to spend six months building a network from scratch. We want someone who already has one.

About us

ActionDesk is an established AI, automation and technology consultancy.

We’ve been operating for almost 10 years, hold recognised accreditations and have an experienced technical and delivery team behind the business.

We help companies use AI and automation to make practical improvements to their business. That can mean increasing lead conversion, improving follow-up, automating admin and onboarding, reactivating old databases, improving compliance processes or removing repetitive operational work.

The important bit is that we’re not selling AI for the sake of AI. We look for genuine commercial or operational problems and build systems that solve them.

The role

Your job is straightforward: create opportunities and win business within commercial finance.

That could mean working with:

• Commercial mortgage brokers

• Asset finance brokers

• Bridging firms

• Invoice finance businesses

• Specialist lenders

• Commercial finance networks

• Other businesses operating in the sector

We also want you developing relationships with potential introducers and partners who can bring us into their own client base.

If you’re good at opening doors but don’t want to handle the technical side of a deal, that’s fine.

We can join discovery calls, run demonstrations, help scope opportunities, prepare proposals and support you with closing. Once something is sold, our team delivers it.

We’ll also provide leads and accounts where we can, as well as specific companies and potential partners for you to approach.

What can you earn?

This is a commission-only position with uncapped earnings.

You can earn up to 15% commission on business you generate, with commission payable for up to two years, depending on the service and commercial agreement.

The numbers can become meaningful quickly.

For example, a recent deal worth around £50,000 would have generated approximately £6,000 in initial commission, with further monthly commission after that under the relevant agreement.

That's one client.

Build a portfolio of good accounts and you're building recurring income rather than starting from zero every month.

What we give you

You’ll have:

• Up to 15% commission for up to two years

• Uncapped earnings

• Fully remote working

• Flexible hours

• Support closing deals

• Technical people available for client meetings

• Proposal and pricing support

• Demonstrations and solution design

• Marketing and sales material

• Warm leads where available

• Accounts and opportunities where available

• Lists of potential introducers and partners to target

• CRM and pipeline support

• Product and sales training

• Cybersecurity awareness training

• A delivery team that takes over once the work is won

We’re not expecting you to become an AI engineer.

We need you to understand the client, recognise an opportunity and get us into the right conversations.

Who we're looking for

This will suit someone who has spent a few years in commercial finance and has built up a genuine network.

You might be a:

• Lender BDM

• Broker Development Manager

• Relationship Director

• Account Manager

• Commercial Finance Broker

• Business Development Manager

• Supplier or technology salesperson selling into commercial finance

You need to be comfortable talking to owners and senior decision-makers and confident enough to pick up the phone and speak to people

Proven professional experience in full stack development, with a strong focus on Java backend engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
Practical experience designing and developing REST APIs and microservices.
Experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven architectures.
Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL.
Hands-on experience with modern Angular and TypeScript, including the development of frontend components and application features.
Familiarity with Elasticsearch and Kibana for basic search, monitoring, and data visualization tasks.
Experience with Docker and working knowledge of Kubernetes.
Experience using GitLab for version control and collaborative development; familiarity with GitLab CI/CD is an advantage.
Understanding of cloud-native application development, deployment, and distributed systems.
Good knowledge of software engineering best practices, testing, debugging, and code review processes.
French proficiency at B2 level, with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment.
Good English communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote team environment.

title: Manager, Software Engineering (App Infrastructure)
description:
At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Engineering Team
The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm ’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.
About the Role
The App Infra team at Affirm empowers other engineering teams to deliver delightful iOS and Android mobile app experiences to our customers. As the Engineering Manager for the App Infra team, you will own the app architecture, building blocks, and processes that make it easy for Affirm engineers to build user-facing features for our mobile apps with high velocity and quality.
What You’ll Do

• Define and drive the vision and roadmap for Mobile App Infrastructure Engineering at Affirm , focusing on app architecture, developer productivity, app reliability, performance, and industry best practices.

• Lead and grow a team of senior engineers building a mobile app platform and tooling that empowers other Affirm engineers to ship reliable, performant, user-facing features with high velocity.

• Build trust and drive alignment across engineering, product, design, and leadership on cross-team efforts.

• Make hands-on technical contributions on a regular basis.

What We Look For

• You have 5+ years of hands-on mobile app and web engineering experience, including 3+ years working with React Native and 3+ years managing and growing engineering teams.

• You have transformed how mobile or web applications were built at a company.

• You have built and delivered new consumer-facing mobile apps end to end.

• You have scaled at least one mobile app to more than 1 million monthly active users.

• You have a proven track record of building alignment and driving outcomes across teams in complex environments without direct authority.

• You have the technical judgment required to guide architecture, quality, and reliability decisions.

• You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

• You are a humble, team-first leader who builds a high-trust team culture.

• You possess exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and organizational influence skills.

• This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - P
Equity Grade - 13
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $230,000 - $290,000

title: Laboratory Technician
description:
Laboratory Technician 

About the Company 

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs-by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects. 

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations. 

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

 

About the Role

GrainLab is KoBold's mineral grain identification lab in Sudbury, Ontario. We combine microscopic and various analytical methods to find and confirm indicator minerals in heavy mineral concentrate (HMC) samples. The samples are delicate and are required to be returned in the same condition, packaging and weight it arrived as, so careful sample handling and accurate weighing are central to the job.

As GrainLab's Laboratory Technician, you will keep the daily sample workflow moving. You will receive and weigh samples, log them in our laboratory information management system (LIMS), prepare imaging trays, and load samples onto our instruments to start imaging and spectroscopy runs. At the end, you will recover every grain and return each sample to its original packaging. You will report to the Sudbury Laboratory Manager and work with KoBold's hardware, data science, software team members. Your observations from the bench will directly shape mineral exploration efforts.

This role suits someone who takes pride in precise, repeatable work, who notices when a number looks wrong, and who wants to see how modern data science is changing mineral exploration.

Responsibilities

Sample receipt, tracking and chain of custody

• Receive incoming client samples; check labels, packaging and paperwork against submission records; report any discrepancies to the Lab Manager.

• Weigh samples on precision balances at defined workflow steps and record the results accurately in the LIMS, using barcode scanners, label printers and balance integration.

• Maintain chain of custody from receipt to return, so every sample can be located and traced at all times.

• Run mass-balance checks at each step, confirm that every sample meets its return-weight tolerance, and escalate any deviation immediately.

The advocacy program is the infrastructure behind it, including the operating model, advocate population, participation standards, platform, and reporting that allow the broader organization to participate effectively.
What you will do
As a Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager, you can expect to:

• Own and maintain the operating model for Intapp 's enterprise client advocacy program, including intake processes, participation criteria, and program governance.

• Establish and enforce standards for how client advocates are identified, onboarded, engaged, and recognized across the organization.

• Serve as the primary coordination point for advocacy across the business, and drive internal adoption of program processes so the broader organization participates effectively.

• Lead the rollout and ongoing management of the advocacy platform that will serve as the system of record for reference fulfillment and advocate engagement, including configuration, user enablement, and adoption.

• Create and oversee processes that enable reference fulfillment for sales, analyst relations, and other teams requiring client validation, matching requests to the right advocates efficiently and without overburdening individual clients.

• Develop and grow the advocate population by creating automations to identify advocates and working with client success and account teams, using signals such as NPS and CSAT data, to find clients who are positioned and willing to participate. What you will need
Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Senior Client Advocacy and References Manager role, you will ideally have:

• 5-7 years of experience, including a demonstrated ability to build and manage program infrastructure: intake processes, reference tracking systems, participation frameworks, and reporting cadences.

Our Payments team⭐

Payments is at the heart of Monzo. It’s how our customers move, receive, spend and manage their money, from cards and bank transfers to cross-border payments, merchant acquiring, payment experiences in the app, and the platform infrastructure that underpins the whole bank.

This role sits in our Payments Platform area, working most closely with our Finance Infrastructure squad. The squad sits in Payments, but partners deeply with Finance teams to build the systems, abstractions and capabilities Monzo needs to operate safely, scale efficiently, and expand into new markets. You’ll work on foundational financial infrastructure: the ledgers, data, controls, reporting, reconciliation and platform capabilities that help Monzo understand, account for and manage money across the bank.

This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited by complex, technical infrastructure. The work is often behind the scenes, but it’s business-critical: it helps Monzo scale, launch new products and markets, support Finance, and keep the bank running safely.

 

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

• Building the roadmap for  Finance Infrastructure within Payments Platform and executing on it.

• Partnering closely with Engineering, Finance and Payments leaders to understand what Monzo needs from its financial systems today and as we scale.

• Translating complex finance, accounting, operational and regulatory needs into scalable platform capabilities.

• Prioritising across competing stakeholder needs, balancing urgent delivery with long-term system health.

• Helping Monzo build financial infrastructure that can support multiple products, entities, countries, currencies and regulatory environments.

• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Engineering, Product and Operations.

 

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

• You’re a strong Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.

• You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.

• You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.

• You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.

• You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.

• You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.

• You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply- even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £80,000 - £100,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

✅ We can sponsor your visa. 

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

description:
ABOUT CUSPAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

As we grow, we are seeking a Platform Engineer with strong Python coding, DevOps and cloud platform expertise to build and maintain the infrastructure that powers our ML research teams. You will be the architect of the systems that enable our researchers to train and deploy models at scale.

 

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will build and maintain the ML infrastructure platform that empowers our AI researchers and materials scientists to conduct cutting-edge experiments.

 

You will help to build and maintain the entire ML operations stack - from cloud architecture to deployment pipelines - ensuring our research teams can focus on science while you handle the systems.

 

You will be part of a newly created team working with our VP ML Engineering, in which you will have the chance to help shape our entire ML infrastructure strategy and make a significant impact on our platform's architecture.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build the ML Infrastructure Platform: Design and implement a cloud-native platform on Kubernetes that enables researchers to easily train, evaluate, and deploy models without worrying about infrastructure complexity.

- Own the MLOps Stack: Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, model registries, experiment tracking systems, and deployment automation - the full lifecycle of ML operations.

- Scale Distributed ML Model Training: Build infrastructure to support distributed training across many GPUs, implementing solutions for data pipelines, checkpointing, and resource optimisation.

- Platform Reliability: Ensure 99.9% uptime for our ML platform through monitoring, alerting, and automated recovery systems. Be the guardian of infrastructure stability.

- Configuration Management: Use Kapitan to manage complex multi-environment Kubernetes configurations and ensure consistent deployments across dev, staging, and production.

- Cost Optimisation: Implement resource management strategies to optimise cloud spending and detect inefficient usage while maximising computational throughput for our research teams.

- Developer Experience: Create tools and abstractions that make it simple for researchers to go from experiment to production without deep infrastructure knowledge.

title: Planning Data Analyst
description:
About RAW Nutrition

RAW Nutrition and BUM Energy are led by entrepreneur Dr. Domenic Iacovone, six-time Mr. Olympia Champion Chris Bumstead, and renowned bodybuilding coach Matt Jansen. RAW Nutrition has been recognized as the #1 fastest-growing sports nutrition company by Inc. 5000 and recently named Brand of the Year by both GNC and The Vitamin Shoppe. 

Since its inception in 2019, every RAW Nutrition product has been made with premium, clean ingredients, free from unnecessary fillers and additives. RAW proudly carries the Informed-Sport certification, a mark of excellence that ensures our products are rigorously tested for prohibited substances and meet the highest standards of quality and safety. We are a team of athletes, creators, and innovators driven by authenticity and the relentless pursuit of being better. Whether you’re behind the barbell, behind the camera, or behind the keyboard, you’ll be joining a culture that values grit, growth, and excellence.

About the Role

We are looking for an Analyst to join our Demand Planning team and support our rapid growth in the CPG space. We need a dedicated team member to handle the day-to-day operational tasks so our leadership can focus on higher-level strategic work. In this position, you'll be responsible for data entry into Confido (our trade promotion and forecasting platform), entering forecast updates, managing trade promotions, ensuring new items flow correctly from NetSuite into Confido, verifying pricing accuracy, and manually uploading Excel files into our systems.

Primary Responsibilities

• Enter and maintain all key inputs in Confido, forecast entries, pricing, new item setup, product and retailer mapping, and trade promotions (when needed)

• Partner with Sales and Supply Planners, and other teams as needed, to translate FLINT submissions and other inputs into Confido

• Monitor all Confido modules for data integrity, reconciling against NetSuite and other source documents and flagging discrepancies

• Assist Finance with coding customer deductions and supporting dispute resolution

• Prepare recurring reports and data pulls for the team

• Keep documentation and process checklists current so the work is repeatable and scalable

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in CPG, sales operations, or supply chain

• Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and lookups

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with syndicated data (e.g., SPINS, Circana, NielsenIQ) and trade promotion management systems is a plus

• NetSuite experience is a plus

Benefits & Compensation

•
Compensation: The salary range is $55,000-$65,000; final salary offer based on experience and skillset.

•
Remote Schedule: With preference for candidates in the Central and Eastern time zones of the US.

•
Insurance & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans.

•
Retirement Savings: Plan for your future with a 401(k) savings plan featuring a company match.

•
Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need with a flex PTO plan, sick time, and paid holidays.

•
Extra Perks: Monthly stipend to spend on our products and gear and access to the RAW Athletic Clubs in Port St. Lucie and Stuart, FL (for our hybrid employees.)

title: Brokerage and RIA CCO
description:
About us

We’re a fast-growing fintech on a mission to redefine how Latin America manages its finances and this is your opportunity to be a crucial part of that transformation. Join a team of top talent from the world’s leading fintech and tech companies, and help build a cross-border financial system that’s modern, accessible, and built to scale.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for a Chief Compliance Officer to lead ARQ’s US investment compliance functions, serve as CCO for our SEC-registered investment adviser, and act as the proposed CCO for our introducing broker-dealer through its FINRA New Member Application (NMA) and launch. You will bring prior CCO experience across both SEC-registered RIAs and FINRA broker-dealers, with a strong understanding of digital investment platforms and clearing broker relationships.

This is a hands-on role. You will oversee the RIA’s compliance program, help lead the broker-dealer application, and build the supervisory framework for launch. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, the BSA/AML Officer, and the outsourced FINOP to embed effective controls in ARQ’s investment offering.

What you’ll do:

1. RIA program ownership: Administer the RIA’s compliance policies, risk assessment, monitoring, testing, and documented annual review. Maintain the compliance calendar and report material risks and remediation progress to leadership.

2. FINRA application and launch: Help lead the NMA with FINRA, counsel, and internal teams. Develop written supervisory procedures, prepare supporting materials, respond to information requests, participate in the membership interview, and verify compliance readiness before launch.

3. Broker dealer supervision: Build and lead the compliance and supervisory framework for a fully disclosed introducing broker offering self-directed trading. Establish assigned supervisory responsibilities, account and transaction reviews, supervisory testing, escalation processes, and required annual reporting.

4. Digital investment advice: Oversee compliance controls for automated, non-discretionary recommendations, including client questionnaires, risk profiles, portfolio methodology, algorithm testing, change management, and ongoing monitoring. Maintain clear disclosures and separation between advisory recommendations and independent customer trading.

5. Marketing and communications: Review investment marketing, performance presentations, promotions, app content, and customer communications against applicable SEC and FINRA standards. Maintain approval records and electronic communications supervision.

6. Disclosures and registrations: Manage Form ADV, Form CRS, Form BD, relevant amendments, and client delivery obligations. Coordinate individual registrations, continuing education, advisory agreements, and customer disclosures.

7. Conflicts and conduct: Maintain the code of ethics and controls for personal trading, outside business activities, gifts and entertainment, and affiliate conflicts. Oversee fiduciary-duty controls and assess custody implications, fees, and collateral arrangements.

8. Clearing and brokerage operations: Oversee compliance with introducing and clearing responsibilities, including account opening, order handling, applicable best execution obligations, transfers, and customer complaints. Coordinate with the clearing broker and outsourced FINOP on operational controls and regulatory obligations.

9. Records and customer protection: Maintain compliant books and records, communications retention, privacy and safeguarding controls, and complaint handling. Work with Security and Engineering on incident response and customer notification processes.

10. Examinations and coordination: Lead SEC and FINRA examinations and inquiries, coordinate audits and remediation, and train employees. Partner with the BSA/AML Officer on investment-related financial crime risks and clearly document responsibilities across teams.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse clients.

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working with clients, and cross-functional teams, you'll ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.

- Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of ML systems.

- Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.

- Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility and impact.

- Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning at scale.

- Acting as a technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts for stakeholders.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

- You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.

- You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
FP Markets Group of Companies is a well-established multi-regulated broker, found in Australia, offering traders access to CFD trading on Forex, Indices, Commodities, Stocks and Cryptocurrencies. We are growing and looking to recruit a Full-time Business Development Manager (Remote) .
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Business Development Manager to drive the growth of our company. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial markets, a proven track record of acquiring and managing clients or partners (such as IBs and affiliates), and a deep understanding of the retail and/or institutional trading landscape.
Responsibilities:

• Identify, develop, and onboard new Introducing Brokers (IBs), affiliates, and partners in assigned regions

• Drive client acquisition and revenue growth through direct outreach, referrals, events, and partnerships

• Develop and execute business development strategies in line with company goals

• Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, partners, and affiliates

• Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes in the FX/CFD industry

• Collaborate with marketing and compliance teams to ensure campaigns and partnerships are aligned and compliant

• Prepare regular reports, forecasts, and pipeline updates for the Regional Director

• Represent the company at industry events, expos, and webinars

Candidate Profile:

• 2+ years of experience in a business development/sales role within the Forex / CFDs or financial trading industry is a must

• Strong network of IBs, affiliates, or HNW retail/institutional clients

• Solid understanding of MT4/MT5,cTrader and TradingView platforms, and the structure of brokerage services

• Fluent in English (additional languages are an advantage)

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills

• Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable working independently or in a remote environment

• Understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements

Our offer:

• Welcoming, young and multicultural team with approachable leadership

• Ability to contribute to dynamic business at a growth phase

• High level of autonomy, support of ideas and putting your expertise into the best practices for the company

• Continuous personal development, training budget, growth with the company and opportunity to learn from industry leaders

• Competitive remuneration, regular salary reviews and performance-based incentive schemes

• Vibrant company life: from team activities to global celebrations

• Corporate equipment

• Fully remote work

Journey to FP Markets :

description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years , we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.
About the Role
This role works closely with the Enterprise Business and Technology Solutions (EBTS) Division to develop, implement, and enhance processes that identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities across Horizon’s technology environment. The analyst is responsible for performing internal and external vulnerability assessments, managing vulnerability scanning programs, establishing security standards, and evaluating exceptions and false-positive findings.

The position plays a key role in reducing organizational risk by partnering with technology teams to prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities, developing long-term security solutions, and supporting threat intelligence and threat hunting initiatives. The incumbent will stay current on emerging threats, industry standards, and security trends, providing regular updates and recommendations to leadership regarding risks requiring remediation. • Communicate current risk exposure, remediation efforts, and security recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

• Create, update, and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and process documentation related to vulnerability management and threat intelligence operations.

• Ensure security controls, policies, and standards are operating effectively to satisfy audit and regulatory requirements.

• Assist in the development and maturation of a threat hunting program by documenting threat scenarios, response playbooks, and use cases.

• Collaborate with internal teams to investigate, validate, and resolve vulnerability findings, false positives, and remediation exceptions.

• Experience supporting security audits, regulatory compliance reviews, and risk management programs preferred.

title: Structural Engineer
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

ROLE SCOPE

- Engineer the structures: modular units, equipment supports, and buildings designed for fast fabrication and faster erection.

- Own the structural calcs and drawings: steel designed to AISC, stamp-ready, and detailed for the factory.

- Design for shipping and lifting: modules that survive the road and the crane, engineered rather than assumed.

- Standardize the structural reference design so every site starts from proven steel.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

- You've designed structural steel for industrial or modular construction.

- Your connections and members calc out and build clean.

- You've engineered lifting, transport, and erection conditions.

- You work with fabricators and respect what the shop can hold.

- You've sealed or supported sealed packages through permitting.

- Bonus: PE or SE license. Tekla interface. Seismic design depth. Modular and skid structures.

We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

title: Military Writing Specialist
description:
Role Title: Military Writing Specialist
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (US Only)
micro1 is engaging Military Writing Specialists to support a unique project, leveraging expertise in military writing and reporting. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will use their background in Department of War (Department of Defense) documentation to generate, review, and evaluate a wide range of reports, summaries, and status updates reflective of authentic military processes. Your input will help develop benchmarks and grading guidelines that will teach AI to understand and replicate effective, compliant government communication.
Scope of Work

• Create realistic military and federal status reports, summaries, and executive updates based on prompts and supplied artifacts.

• Develop “golden responses” that demonstrate high-quality, standards-aligned reporting for use in AI model training.

• Draft grading rubrics and guidelines that reflect best practices in federal and military writing assessment.

• Evaluate AI-generated reports, providing detailed feedback in both written and verbal form.

• Share context on stylistic differences and individual approaches to common military documents (e.g., WARs, SITREPs, AARs, executive summaries).

• Produce supporting documents such as decision briefs, memoranda, and action officer updates when required.

• Collaborate with other subject matter experts to ensure diversity of reporting styles and adherence to branch-specific terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

• Former U.S. Department of War (Department of Defense) professional with at least 3 years of relevant experience.

• Experience producing templated and standard reports such as Weekly Activity Reports (WARs), Situation Reports (SITREPs), After-Action Reviews, or similar artifacts.

• Expertise spanning two or more branches of the U.S. military is a plus; a diverse background across roles is highly valued.

• Proven proficiency in written and verbal communication, particularly in conveying technical or operational subject matter.

• Demonstrated ability to craft, grade, and review back office documents, PowerPoints, memos, and spreadsheets for military or federal purposes.

• US-based contributor with broad familiarity with federal documentation standards and compliance best practices.

• Comfortable collaborating remotely and sharing insights on nuanced, highly procedural reporting tasks.

title: Team Lead People Operations (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We are looking for a hands-on, people-first Team Lead (m/f/d) to lead our People Operations delivery in Germany and grow into a broader European leadership role over time.

At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a direct line to the employee experience of thousands of colleagues. Our People Ops team owns its processes end to end, shapes how they evolve, and co-develops solutions together with our Centers of Excellence, People Partners, and business leaders. The starting point for this role is Germany, our largest and most complex market. From day one, you also contribute to European-level initiatives and build familiarity with our broader operational landscape across markets. As Flix’s People Operations function scales, this role scales with it - toward a wider European scope, a larger team, and ownership of operational HR delivery across multiple countries. We are looking for someone who is motivated by that trajectory.

We are also working through a significant digital transformation of our HR function, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work across the company. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together.

This role is based in Berlin or Munich (hybrid model ).

About the Role

• Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the Service & Support Germany team (currently 4 to 5 FTE) with clear ownership of performance, quality standards, and workload distribution

• Operational Ownership for Germany: Take full accountability for HR service quality, SLA compliance, and end-to-end employee lifecycle delivery for all German entities.

• Process Co-Creation: Together with the Excellence HQ team and other CoEs, actively develop, challenge, and improve how HR operations runs. You shape processes, not just execute them

• European Contribution: Contribute to European-level initiatives and cross-country projects from day one. Build relationships with local POMs across our European markets and develop an understanding of how People Ops works across different countries

• Digital Transformation: Contribute to cross-functional HR transformation projects, adopt new tooling, and explore where automation can make People Ops more scalable

About You

• Experience: 7+ years in HR Operations or People Services, with at least 2 years in a lead or senior role, ideally in a high-volume environment

• German HR Expert: Deep, hands-on knowledge of German employment law, HR administration processes, and the employee lifecycle

• People Leader : Coaching mindset, ability to set clear expectations, and proven track record of developing team members

• European Ambition: You want broader scope and more complexity over time. Experience with multi-country HR or European operations is a strong plus

• Process Thinker & AI Mindset : You have opinions on how processes should work and spot gaps proactively. You are genuinely curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations and want to be part of shaping that. You do not need to be an expert today, but the interest and openness need to be there.

• Languages: fluent English (must-have); fluent German (strong plus)

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

• Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

• Work from (M)Any
